LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 5.3.1 WORD CLASS: ADJECTIVES

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.3: Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives, part of Strand 5 in Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: How do we compare things, people or events? 2. Which words are used to describe things or people?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. describe items using the comparative and superlative forms of adjectives e.g. that window is bigger than this one,

2. change positive forms of regular and irregular adjectives to their comparative and superlative forms,

3. pick out adjectives of size, shape and age from a narrative or poem in collaboration with peers,

4. construct sentences featuring adjectives of size, shape and age,

5. fill gaps using adjectives in the correct order,

6. create a crossword puzzle using adjectives. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. describe items using the comparative and superlative forms of adjectives e.g. that window is bigger than this one,
2. change positive forms of regular and irregular adjectives to their comparative and superlative forms,
3. pick out adjectives of size, shape and age from a narrative or poem in collaboration with peers,
4. construct sentences featuring adjectives of size, shape and age,
5. fill gaps using adjectives in the correct order,
6. create a crossword puzzle using adjectives. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and Imagination is enhanced as the learner creates crossword puzzles and make sentences based on

adjectives.

• Digital Literacy is achieved as the learner searches for various adjectives on the internet.

Values:
Peace is enhanced as the learner cooperate with peers to change positive forms of regular and irregular adjectives to

superlative forms.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Environmental Education is enhanced as the learner is exposed to information on traditional foods.

• Hygiene and Nutrition is enhanced as the learner interacts with texts with content on traditional nutritious food.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner uses this knowledge on comparison of adjectives to learn the similar concepts in Kiswahili.
